job_C_portfolio_regime.workload: Portfolio Regime Evaluation (H=4, 69 weeks, cohort stacking)

summary.recommendation: Local M2 MPS delivers 4.98 events/sec (159.4 forward passes/sec) on 32-draw MC inference, completing Fold 3 (576 events) in 115.576s and full benchmark (1,728 events) in ~5.8 minutes. Portfolio backtesting takes 590.7 ms. Full test suite executes in 4.433s (178 tests passing). Cloud GPU (NVIDIA L4 Spot) provides a projected ~15x inference speedup (120-150 events/sec) and should be used for large batch inference (>5,000 events) or multi-epoch model retraining, while local execution remains optimal for quick validation, portfolio backtests, and batches under 2,000 events.
